title: Crypto Blue Stones
tagline: It is 3 side market traders algorithms providers data providers at 1 table inside our oracle .
description:
Crypto Blue Stones is a multi-chain oracle + marketplace for AI/ML agents/scrapers that provides: 
Raw data → raw data from selected sources (blogs, social media, GitHub, press feeds).
Aggregates → processed data (e.g., number of tweets, mention volume, dev-activity index).
Indicators and signals → advanced metrics or trading transactions (e.g., NLP sentence, energy correlation with BTC price). The assessment of whether the feed data has been verified, and to what extent this data is judicially and officially valid, will be carried out by the DAO – a community that detects and holds our main tokens, called governance tokens.
Unlike traditional oracles:
A. In MVP, our special agents operate, calculating coefficients, indices, and various feeds that no one else has.
B. In each user's product, they can deploy their own agent (AI/ML/algorithm) that collects/processes data and shares it with others via the platform.
